meta.description: A production-ready Next.js skeleton: TanStack Query against a REST API, SEO, strict CSP, English and Russian, tests.
meta.ogAlt: Next Starter — Next.js skeleton with working examples

meta.title: Next Starter — Next.js skeleton with working examples
meta.description: Start a web app from a working skeleton: data from a REST API through TanStack Query, SEO, security headers, two languages and tests.

home.heading: A Next.js skeleton that already works
home.lead: Every piece below is wired up and covered by tests. Read the code, keep what you need, delete the notes example when your first feature lands.

features.data: Backend calls through TanStack Query: server prefetch and hydration, an infinite list, an optimistic create with rollback, polling.
features.seo: Titles and descriptions in both languages, canonical and hreflang links, Open Graph card, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, JSON-LD.
features.security: Strict Content Security Policy with a nonce per request, security headers, same-origin API proxy.
features.i18n: English and Russian without URL prefixes: a cookie remembers the choice, ?lang= switches it.
features.quality: Biome, Vitest, Playwright with axe checks, Pino logs, health probes, Docker and CI.

meta.title: Notes
meta.description: Notes from the API: an infinite list, an optimistic create with rollback and stats that update after a create.

notes.heading: Notes
